reply.analysis: Proven: beta = 364 for this 1365-receiver graph. The lower bound is an independent set of size 364 (check passed). The upper bound is a linear code M = I + 6A over F_7 of length 364 (code_fits, factorization and decoding checks all passed), so the bracket [364, 364] is closed. Only 1 code was tried and compute took 0.539 s. Wall time was 33.457 s, of which llm_s was 32.918 s across 2 LLM calls. Against the baselines: CP-SAT reached alpha 364 but proved nothing in about 122 s. CP-SAT cover found no value, frac_cover reached only 1341, and f2_minrank_sat stopped at a lower bound of 363. kushagra_agent also got the exact result, with field 7, in 0.798 s. That is about 42x faster than this agent's wall time, so this agent loses clearly on time. Nothing looks suspicious.
